caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figurine standing upright on a dark, multi-faceted base. The figure has a stylized, elongated form with a light beige or tan body and exaggeratedly long black arms that hang straight down to the sides, ending in blocky, red-tipped hands. The legs are positioned closely together and are similarly colored in black with red bands near the knees and at the feet. The torso is decorated with a pattern of red dots down the center and red accents at the waist and collar, imitating buttons and a bow tie. The head is oval-shaped, also in a light color, with facial features including black, almond-shaped eyes, an angular nose, and a small mouth. The top of the head and sides are shaded in black, and the figure is shown in a frontal view, centrally positioned on a cream or off-white rectangular background with a faint border sketched around the image.
title: Whirligig
